Host fold: accept, history [system, summary, plain], dangling []. Twin fold: refused `digest` (Digest at the last append).
notes: Model actions 5,6,0; Lean bug_twin_checkpoint_then_resume (axioms: propext). Holds across processes too (adopted host also accepts). 65 of the 76 P3.1 violations among the 2,313 enumerated runs; the one-line fix `{ next | digest: i.digest_after, replaced_since_seed: true }` closes all 65 (fix_twin_closes_checkpoint_then_resume; T3_FIX=twin case.sh exits 0). notes: Model actions 0,4,6; Lean bug_host_hybrid_call_not_pending. 11 of the 76 P3.1 violations; the one-line fix (call this.updatePending(message) in replaceLastHistoryMessage) closes all 11 (fix_host_closes_hybrid; T3_FIX=host case.sh exits 0).
